tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Cool stone, never cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tables, dialogs, menus, charts: anything that sits on the page.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, hover rows, the selected row and a selected chip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, section dividers, card borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (inputs, selects, outline buttons, checkboxes): ≥3:1 on bg, surface and sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and sunken. Also links (underlined).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row details, descriptions.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, metadata. 4.5:1 on bg, surface and sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: sulphur
tokens.usage: Brand. Solid fill for the main action (header 'Nuevo análisis', a form's or dialog's primary, an empty state's call to action) and the logo. Never a status or severity.

tokens.name: on-sulphur
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sulphur (10.6:1).

tokens.name: sulphur-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight of searched text only. Never a button.

tokens.name: sulphur-line
tokens.usage: Underline of searched text only. Never a button border.

tokens.name: rufous
tokens.usage: The kiskadee's wing. Logo and illustration only, never UI text, links or focus.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Ink on light, sulphur on dark.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Text and icons for failure and the critical/high family: failed runs, errors, 'KEV'.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error message or a critical badge.

tokens.name: critical-line
tokens.usage: Border of an error message or a critical badge.

tokens.name: critical-solid
tokens.usage: Solid fill for the 'Crítica' severity chip and destructive confirm; white text (6.6:1).

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Attention family: medium severity, partial runs, due soon, incomplete setup. Orange, never yellow.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Background for attention badges and notices.

tokens.name: attention-line
tokens.usage: Border for attention badges and notices.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success family: completed, connected, fixed, verified.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and notices.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Border for success badges and notices.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information family: low severity, running/queued, neutral notices.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for info badges and notices.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border for info badges and notices.

tokens.name: sev-critical
tokens.usage: Severity Crítica: solid chip with white text.

tokens.name: sev-high
tokens.usage: Severity Alta: critical text on critical-soft.

tokens.name: sev-medium
tokens.usage: Severity Media: attention text on attention-soft.

tokens.name: sev-low
tokens.usage: Severity Baja: info text on info-soft.

tokens.name: sev-info
tokens.usage: Severity Info: muted text, outline only.

tokens.name: chart-critical
tokens.usage: The Crítica series in charts, darker than Alta so the two read apart; ≥3:1 on surface in both themes. Chips keep sev-critical.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axes.

tokens.name: chart-neutral
tokens.usage: Single-series bars (CWE counts, activity) and the 'found' trend line.

tokens.name: chart-fixed
tokens.usage: The 'fixed' trend line and fixed counts.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page's h1. One per view.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: h2 of a section or dialog.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Recorre tu sitio o API como un visitante. Nunca ataca.
styles.usage: Default text, table cells, form text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, labels of the active item.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Visto por última vez el 10 oct 2026
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a row title.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Key figure labels, column headers, hints. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, paths, hosts in scope lists, CVE and rule ids, versions. Nothing else is mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; row vertical padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; field label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside dialogs and tables; between fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding on wide screens; before the footer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, kbd hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tables, dialogs, charts. Nothing is rounder.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, selects.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette. Flat surfaces have no shadow.
